edition.title: Piorum hominum societates — Sodalitas Sanctissimi et Afflictissimi Cordis Mariae de Mouilleron in archisodalitatem erigitur — Rome: Ex Typographia Polyglotta S. C. de Propaganda Fide, 1902.

work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CXCVI raises the confraternity of the Most Holy and Afflicted Heart of Mary at Mouilleron-le-Captif (diocese of Luçon) to an archconfraternity with power of aggregation; intitulation, narrative, grant, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF36459–36459; the source dating clause at LF36544–36547 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die septima februarii mille- simo octingentesimo quadragesimo tertio, pon- tificatus Nostri anno decimo tertio. Isolated OCR marks fused into body lines remain literal and are not removed or corrected: LF36505 “‘usu”. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
